description: No CDASH standard governs a generic Positive/Negative/Unknown result flag -- this is sponsor-defined per protocol. Detroit's LUPUS form (12 fields: RESARTH, RESDR, RESER1, RESER2, RESHD1, RESMR, RESND1, RESND2, RESOU, RESPH, RESRD1A, RESRD2) and RA form (5 fields: ARTH_RES, MORNSTIFF_RES, RADI_RES, RHEUM_RES, SYMMJOI_RES) independently defined the identical list under two different names (result, rares). Pure deduplication within Detroit, not a Precision/Detroit cross-study case.
source: No CDASH standard exists; consolidating identical existing values found within Detroit's own spec
